description: This file defines the IndexingPatternFinder structure with static methods for pattern detection related to indexing in TorchScript JIT IR. It serves as a utility header for pattern conversion and encapsulation in ONNX conversion workflows.

classes.name: IndexingPatternFinder
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods to identify and fetch specific indexing patterns within TorchScript JIT IR nodes.

methods.name: FetchSliceAndSelect
methods.description: Fetches slice and select nodes from a given node if they match specific patterns.

methods.name: IsSameSource
methods.description: Checks if two nodes originate from the same source, used internally for pattern matching.
